activities.description: The Mutianyu section of the wall, steep and far less crowded than Badaling, then the lake and long corridor of the Summer Palace.

activities.name: Universal Studios Beijing

program.name: Beijing
program.description: Three nights in the capital with the wall at Mutianyu, the Summer Palace and a full day at Universal Studios Beijing.

day_titles.2: Great Wall and the Summer Palace

1: Arrival at Beijing Capital and transfer to your hotel
Check in and the rest of the day free
Optional: the National Museum on Tiananmen Square
Optional: Peking duck at a neighbourhood restaurant
2: Early breakfast, then north to Mutianyu
The cable car and the walk along the wall
On to the Summer Palace in the afternoon
Kunming lake, the long corridor and the marble boat
3: Early breakfast, then out to Universal Studios
Tickets included for the full day
The Harry Potter area and the water park rides
Back at the hotel in the evening
4: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to the airport for your flight home

expert.name: Mei
expert.quote: Three nights, two big days. It is the short Beijing break people take when they only have a long weekend to spare.
expert.tip: Take the toboggan down from the wall at Mutianyu. It is quicker than the cable car queue and the children will talk about it for weeks.

summary: Four days in the Chinese capital with daily breakfast: a full guided day on the Great Wall at Mutianyu with the Summer Palace, and a full day at Universal Studios Beijing with tickets included.
included: Included: 3 nights in Beijing with daily breakfast; private airport transfers; full day guided tour of the Great Wall at Mutianyu and the Summer Palace; Universal Studios Beijing tickets; visa assistance.
not_included: Not included: international flights; China visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
